newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Options wide open on TVNZ, says NZ govt.
newsitem.headline: Options wide open on TVNZ, says NZ govt.

text.p: State-owned Enterprises Minister Jenny Shipley and Communications Minister Maurice Williamson said on Tuesday that options were still wide open for the operation of Television New Zealand.
The ministers said the Coalition Agreement signed in December agreed a review would take place for:
- consideration of private sector management of TV2
- monitoring financial performance of regional television.
The ministers said the the agreement reflected growing public sentiment in favour of balancing commercial requirements with quality and values.
"All options are still open," they said in a statement.
"Interested parties will be consulted before final decisions are taken."
The options would be developed over the next six months.
